# Engineering behind Boutique Empresarial: Static Architecture, SDD and Agentic development

The video shows the engineering behind the Boutique Empresarial site: a unique conversion funnel, a static and fast basis, specification-oriented development, AI subagents, a quality gate that blocks any error and a design without unnecessary movement.

Video by Maurício Yokoyama Issei, published on September 21, 2026 (9 min 32 s).
Watch: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5LtvpFMRUvw

_The video and the transcript are in Portuguese. The minutes between brackets, such as [04:12], point to the excerpt of the video._

## A simple site on the outside

At first glance, the Boutique Empresarial website is a minimalist page. Below, there is a conversion system built, tested and maintained almost entirely by an AI-guided architecture [00:00]. The video uses the image of an iceberg: it begins at the visible tip and descends to where agents work [00:21].

## A unique funnel

The project exists for a reason: there are no menus or endless pages. Everything leads to a single journey [01:02]. Her center is a seven-step form for free diagnosis, which qualifies the contact [01:24].

Thus, the system filters and qualifies contact before any conversation with a person, and the team saves hours of manual triage [01:46].

## A minimum and fast base

There are no heavy frameworks or large libraries in the browser. The base is HTML and static CSS [02:07]. With Vite and Tailwind CSS, and with hosting at AWS on S3 and CloudFront, the pages load in milliseconds [02:27].

## Specification-oriented development

Decisions are taken before writing the code [03:07]. In the specification-oriented development (SDD), the documentation folder is the code law: when the requirement changes, the documentation changes first without exception [03:07].

This takes away the divination, both for people and for AI [03:29]. The documents in the repository say: "Documentation is the source of truth" [03:29].

The site is also made for AI agents. While people read HTML, search engines with AI read structured files such as `llms.txt` and WebMCP manifests [04:10]. It is what is called the AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) [04:30].

## The wake of AI agents

The vibe coding here is not letting AI improvise [04:51]. The AI executes detailed contracts and specifications; the rules come from documentation [05:11].

In Claude Code, the work is divided between five specialized subagents [05:32]:

- one reads the page [05:32];
- one fixes the code header [05:32];
- one writes texts focusing on SEO [05:32];
- one creates test suites [05:32];
- a wheel the final quality check [05:53].

## The Quality Gate

No agent, human or AI, gives a task yet completed before the validation command turns green [06:14]. It builds the site, runs tests on three browsers and requires zero accessibility violations [06:35]. The model is fail-closed: any error for the process [06:35].

After the merge in the main branch, the pipeline runs the tests, builds, authenticates in the cloud, sends the files and clears the old cache [06:56]. Deploy is all automatic, and this is what lets the speed of AI reach the user without breaking anything [06:56].

## Design: silence and elegance

The institutional website uses a cream background, a dark ink color typography and a thin gold line to mark the hierarchy [07:38]. Social media materials have their own palette, more vibrant, and the two palettes never mix [07:59].

The site does not use background video, animations that distract or scroll with parallax effect [08:19]. The movement only appears as a response to a user action, and this also helps fast loading [08:19].

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What happens if a test fails?

The process stops. The quality gate is failed, and no task is given by completion until the command turns green [06:35].

### Why doesn't the site use animations?

To maintain clarity and speed. The movement appears only as a response to a user action [08:19].

## About the video

In this video, we present the software engineering and the agency methodology used in the development of **Boutique Empresarial**. 

Follow how we combine high web performance (static MPA with less than 1 second load), specification-oriented development (SDD), multi-agent automation and preparation for AI engines and AI agents (AEO/WebMCP).

---

🔗 **IMPORTANT LINKS:**
* 🌐 **Official website:** https://boutiqueempresarial.com.br/
* 💻 **Repository on GitHub:** https://github.com/issei/boutiqueempresarial-site

---

📌 **WHAT YOU'LL SEE IN THIS VIDEO:**

1. **Static Architecture & Single Funnel:** 
   Construction of a static Multi-Page Application (MPA) using Vite 6, Tailwind CSS v4 and pure HTML/CSS without hydration or heavy JS frameworks in the customer. Total focus on a unique conversion funnel (Free Diagnosis Landing Page → 7-step conversational form → Confirmation page).

2. **Specification Driven Development (SDD) & VibeCoded:** 
   Understand how `docs/specs/` specifications function as the unique source of truth before any code change, allowing a quick implementation flow guided by clear contracts.

3. **Pipeline Multi-Agent (Claude Code):** 
   The agency structure of the project with specialized subagents (`page-auditor`, `head-fixer`, `copy-writer`, `test-author`, `gate-runner`), following the principle: *"Dear model decides, cheap model executes, the arbitrator gate"*.

4. **Deterministic Quality Gate (Fail-Closed):** 
   The operation of the `npm run gate` command, which runs Vite build, E2E cross-browser tests with Playwright and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit via `axe-core`.

5. **CI/CD Automated on AWS via OIDC:** 
   The DevOps flow in GitHub Actions with temporary JWT authentication (no fixed keys) integrated into AWS S3, CloudFront Functions and Route 53.

6. **AEO & Discovery by Agent Readiness:** 
   As the site is structured for machine-readable content with `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, manifests in `/.well-known/`, HTTP Link headers (RFC 8288), DNS-AID and runtime records WebMCP (`navigator.modelContext`).

---

🛠️ **TECHNOLOGIES AND FERRAMENTS USED:**
* **Frontend:** Vite 6, Tailwind CSS v4, HTML5/CSS3 Vanilla
* **Tests & Quality:** Playwright, @axe-core/playwright
* **& Cloud Backend:** AWS S3, CloudFront, Route 53 (DNSEC/DNS-AID), CloudFront Functions
* **CI/CD:** GitHub Actions with OIDC
* **Form Backend:** Google Apps script
* **Genetic Harness:** Claude Code, APM, MCP (Context7, CodeGraph, Playwright-MCP)
